### Strength When Your Social Battery Is Low
Author: Clarence L. Haynes Jr.
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-nightly-prayer/strength-when-your-social-battery-is-low.html
Passage: Exodus 15:2
Points:
- Demanding seasons can leave us exhausted and depleted, much like an overextended boxer.
- Human strength is a finite resource that was never meant to fight life's battles alone.
- Moses’ song shows that God Himself is the ultimate source of our power and victory.
- Resting in God's presence allows Him to fight on our behalf and replenish our endurance.

### God Parted the Seas for You
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/god-parted-the-seas-for-you
Passage: Exodus 15:2, 11
Points:
- Trapped between an oncoming army and the sea, Israel experienced total deliverance through divine intervention.
- The crossing of the Red Sea foreshadows the greater rescue accomplished by Christ on the cross.
- Remembering God's rescue lifts believers out of despair and inspires genuine praise.
- True salvation leads God's people to cherish Him not only as Savior, but as their song.

### Superman
Author: Luann Prater
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-aug-20-2010-11636657.html
Passage: Exodus 15:2
Points:
- People often view God through a limited, static lens rather than experiencing His living power.
- Exodus 15:2 highlights God as multi-faceted—our strength, song, and personal deliverance.
- God remains faithful, loving, and sufficient regardless of whether our circumstances change immediately.
- Stepping out in trust allows us to encounter His fullness and discover that He is everything we need.

### Time with God - August 31
Author: Time with God
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/timewithgod/time-with-god-august-31-2025.html
Passage: Exodus 15:2
Points:
- Stress, worry, and difficult circumstances often appear like insurmountable giants.
- Focusing on our problems magnifies their size and causes us to lose sight of God.
- Intentional worship alters our vantage point by directing attention to Jesus' victory.
- Praising God allows us to exchange human weakness and fear for His strength and courage.
